PPL

Pillarion Match Control

A self-contained browser match game inspired by the MicrasWiki Pillarion rules.
⚽ feet-only • 🏛️ pillar strikes • ⏱️ tactical holds

Take charge from the sand court touchline.

Pick a Professional Pillarion League club, set a tactic, and call each possession. You decide when to build through the tactical zones, when to press, and when to risk a direct strike at the opponent’s scoring pillar.

6 per sideStrikers, playmakers, defenders, and utility/tactical leaders shape each possession.
2 × 35 minutesThe clock now runs continuously; choose a 2, 5, or 10 minute real-time match.
3-point pillar strikeDirect shots at the opponent’s circular pillar target are high value and high risk.
1-point zone holdKeep control in an opponent-half tactical zone for ten seconds to earn a possession point.

No server and no build tools. MicrasWiki league and club logos are embedded in this file when available, with generated crests as fallbacks; saves stay local to this browser.
